methodology.objectiveIds: Internal AdaptCloud traceability identifiers. They paraphrase the published skill blueprint and are not official exam task IDs.
methodology.familyIds: Internal concept-family identifiers used to prevent scenario variants from being treated as independent knowledge.
methodology.remediation: Original scenarios were added only where the pre-audit bank did not adequately represent the published skill breadth. No live, recalled, screenshot-derived, or copied exam questions are used.
methodology.mockAllocation: Domain mock counts are the repository's frozen 53-item practice geometry, not a claim that Anthropic publishes exact per-domain item counts.
